Both1000x667 JPEGs are the exact public source bytes, downloaded and hash-verified through the repository's manual asset-preparation workflow. They are real existing photographer images; no cropping, person removal, AI generation, image enhancement, compositing or invented day/night conversion is applied. Visible domes/minarets are inside the frame; no visible people or pool/sea. Natural glass/paving highlights remain in these photographs, distinct from a mirrored mosque in a body of water.

Main hero uses intrinsic image dimensions and object-fit:contain. Android widget uses fitCenter. The full source frame is preserved on narrow/wide layouts; launcher size may introduce neutral margins rather than cut off the mosque.
